risks.risk: Console may have hidden faults (HDMI/USB/audio/controller ports) that aren’t visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Short video: PS4 boots to home screen; plug in both controllers; show they navigate menus; show HDMI connected to a TV; demonstrate at least one USB port working (e.g., controller charging or USB device recognized).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not fully tested / possible port faults.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may appear after time, not in a still photo.
risks.proof: Video of 15–20 minutes gameplay or a stress test with no shutdowns; optionally show fan behavior and no overheating warnings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: possible overheating risk.

risks.risk: Game bundle may be overstated (only FIFA 24 is visible).
risks.proof: Photos of Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, and FIFA 26 cases/discs (or a clear photo of the PS4 library showing installed titles).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: only FIFA 24 included.

risks.risk: Controllers may have drift, charging issues, or pairing problems.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers pairing and working in menus; quick stick test in a game/menu; show charging indicator if charging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: controllers may have issues.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 Slim variant/storage not confirmed; value depends on CUH model and HDD size.
risks.proof: Photo of the label showing CUH model number and storage capacity (HDD size).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: unknown variant/storage.

risks.risk: Receipt/originality claims may be false or not verifiable remotely.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details blurred) and/or proof of purchase details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: no valid receipt proof.

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 label showing CUH model number and storage capacity.
Video: PS4 boots to home screen; both controllers connect and work.
Video: HDMI output on a TV + quick USB port test.
Video: 15–20 minutes gameplay/stress test to confirm no overheating/shutdowns.
Photos of all claimed games (Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, FIFA 26) showing discs/cases, or a photo of the PS4 library with those titles installed.
Photo of the UK receipt (blur personal details).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a text assertion and doesn’t add verifiable evidence. With no new photos/videos, the key value drivers (full port functionality, overheating test, and the full game bundle) remain unproven, so pricing safely requires proof.
